issues.title: Webinar registration page confirmation email
issues.problem_statement: The customer's webinar registration page was not sending the confirmation email.

items.description: The confirmation email option in the page settings was switched on and is now showing.
Support explained that the same confirmation email option exists on every page, in the page settings, including the customer's second webinar page.
evidence: Yes, the same option exists on every page, in the page settings.

analysis_notes: Who switched the option on is not established; the result is clear.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with a clear outcome.
